subject: File control entry
notes: LANDED 2026-09-06 (kb/Work PB742). RULE (--check 12.4.5.2 8): "Format 1 shall be specified only for an indexed file. The associated file description entry shall not be a sort-merge file description entry." TWO obligations, and BOTH are screened. Sentence 1 is about a clause 12.4.5.1 prints in Format 1 and in no other format - RECORD KEY, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, and the collating-sequence-clause - written on a file that is not indexed. Measured before the fix: `SELECT F ASSIGN ... RECORD KEY IS K.` with NO ORGANIZATION clause at all (record sequential by 12.4.5.10.3 GR6) compiled with zero diagnostics of any severity, the key name resolved and stored, and then nothing read it, because every key consumer is on a path a sequential file never enters. The screen is TWO ROWS of FileControlKeyRules (prime and alternate), and adding them is what forced that table's scalar Organization column to become a SET (FileKinds): the column conflated the format that CARRIES a clause with the files a rule is IN FORCE over, which are the same for a rule stated inside a format and OPPOSITE for this one. Sentence 2 is a THIRD row on the new FileKeyRole.Entry, because the format may be specified by the ORGANIZATION clause ALONE (SD + ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, no key clause, was also silent) - it reports under COBOL1900, its own code, because the subject is the file description entry rather than a key clause. The COLLATING SEQUENCE operand is screened at DataBinder.ResolveFileCollating (COBOL1582), the second code-location above, because that test is also the guard that stops the rest of that method; its citation was 12.4.5.7.1, the clause's descriptive General paragraph, and is repaired to SR8 here. OVER-REJECTION SWEEP before landing: zero hits across tests/ (1611 file control entries, 230 RECORD KEY / 29 ALTERNATE RECORD KEY / 94 RELATIVE KEY clauses, 263 ORGANIZATION INDEXED); the GPL external corpus is absent from a worktree and was not swept there. The BOUNDARY is measured too: FileControlKeyRuleSpecTests pins that the same clauses on an INDEXED file, and a legal 12.4.5.1 Format 4 sort-merge entry, draw nothing.
